read.thesis: Q1 revenue up 56% to $19.8B on 65% volume growth despite 13% price decline; FY26 revenue guide raised to $82-85B and non-GAAP EPS to $35.50-37.00, with no capacity or capex signal in the release.

triggers.label: Realised prices down 13%
triggers.quote: partially offset by a 13% decrease due to lower realized prices

triggers.label: Revenue guide raised $2B to $82-85B
triggers.quote: Revenue guidance to be in the range of $82.0 billion to $85.0 billion

triggers.label: Volume up 65%
triggers.quote: driven by a 65% increase in volume

triggers.label: Ex-US price down 25% on China NRDL
triggers.quote: lower realized prices outside the U.S. were driven primarily by the addition of Mounjaro to the National Reimbursed Drug List (NRDL) in China

guidance.quote: Increased 2026 full-year revenue guidance to be in the range of $82.0 billion to $85.0 billion
non-GAAP EPS guidance to be in the range of $35.50 to $37.00

red_flags.label: Price erosion: realised prices down 13%, ex-US down 25%
red_flags.quote: partially offset by a 13% decrease due to lower realized prices
